PURPOSE:
  Repository automation, governance, and contributor templates.

SHOULD CONTAIN:
  - workflows/ — CI/CD pipelines
  - ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ — bug, feature, and data-correction templates
  - PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, CODEOWNERS (categories/* -> owning team)

SEE: ADR-0001 (docs/decisions/ADR-0001-Repository-Structure.md)
